home.title: VANGUARD Car Care Products | Founded in 1978
home.description: VANGUARD car care products by KYOEI TAIWAN CORP.: car wash tools, clay bars, car wax, coatings, glass care and polishers. Distributor inquiries welcome.
home.heading: Car oriented, customer first
home.lead: The in-house car care brand of KYOEI TAIWAN CORP. From washing and claying to waxing and coating — a complete range for detailers and distributors.
home.aboutBody: Founded in 1978, KYOEI TAIWAN CORP. is a Taiwan-based car care company that has represented leading US and Japanese brands and develops its own brand, VANGUARD. Its best-known products include the Glass Scale Remover paste, Porcelain Glaze car wax, and the patented CLAY-U clay mitt, now sold across Taiwan and in many international markets.
home.inquiryBody: Add the products you are interested in to your inquiry list and send your company details — no account needed.

bannerAlt.kyoei: KYOEI TAIWAN CORP. ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 certifications and patents
